title: Twilio Conversation Relay - prompt message
description: Source: VoiceRelayWebSocketHandler.java#handlePrompt, read directly (2026-07-19). The handler only acts when last=true AND voicePrompt is non-blank (node.path('last').asBoolean(false), node.path('voicePrompt').asText('')) - a partial/interim transcript (last=false) is a documented no-op, not an error, so this schema treats last=false as equally valid, just inert.

last.description: Only last=true triggers AgentChatService#chat. last=false (interim transcript) is silently ignored by design - not a failure mode.

voicePrompt.description: The caller's utterance. A blank string with last=true is also a silent no-op (handler returns early) - not an error.
